name: Victor's 1959 Cafe
neighborhoodOrCity: Kingfield, south Minneapolis (3756 Grand Ave. S.)
whatItIs: Cuban diner known for breakfast and lunch, ropa vieja, Cuban sandwiches and walls covered in diners' signatures. Minnesota Monthly (2015) says it was opened by Victor Valens, a native of Cuba.
evidence: Undated Infatuation review and older articles (2015, 2020 visit) describe it as operating. Its own website (victors1959cafe.com) blocked access, and no 2025 or 2026 dated page was found.

name: Guava's Cuban Cafe
neighborhoodOrCity: South Minneapolis, Chicago Ave. (reported at 5607 Chicago Ave. in 2018)
whatItIs: Cuban cafe offering online ordering, catering and live-music nights, according to its own site. Ownership not established.
evidence: Own site is live and describes online ordering for pickup or delivery, but current hours or a dated 2025 or 2026 post could not be read.

name: El Cubano
neighborhoodOrCity: St. Paul area (the current page gives 870 Dodd Road, West St. Paul; not confirmed)
whatItIs: Restaurant with a sign advertising Cuban and Dominican food and a colorful patio, per a travel guide. Owners not established.
evidence: Only an undated travel-guide page could be opened; gift-card and review pages blocked access. A Seattle restaurant of the same name is unrelated.

name: Francisco's Restaurant (formerly Francisco's Cuban Cafe)
neighborhoodOrCity: Rochester, near Mayo Clinic's Saint Marys campus
whatItIs: Cuban and Jamaican restaurant founded in 2015 by Cuban-born Francisco Corripio in a downtown skyway food court, later run by his daughter Lisette Nunez-James and Jeffrey James as a sit-down restaurant.
evidence: Post Bulletin article of Feb. 2, 2023 shows it operating; no 2025 or 2026 confirmation found.

name: Yuma Fritas
neighborhoodOrCity: Rochester (808 Broadway Ave. S., Soldiers Field Plaza)
whatItIs: 'Cubanish' restaurant built around fritas, a Cuban street burger, opened by chef Justin Schoville and Lindsay Zubay after a trip to Miami. Cuban-inspired; the article does not describe the owners as Cuban.

name: Nachito Herrera
whatItIs: Cuban-born Latin jazz and classical pianist based in Minnesota for more than 20 years; Immigrants of Distinction award; runs a health care fundraiser for children in Cuba.
evidence: Own site lists Minnesota concerts on Sept. 27, 2025 (White Bear Lake) and Oct. 4, 2025 (Stillwater).

name: Charanga Tropical
whatItIs: Ten-piece charanga band playing boleros, salsa and Cuban classics with violins and flute; describes itself as bringing together Cuban and American musicians; played Havana's International Danzon Festival in 2015.
evidence: Event listing for Sept. 5, 2026 at The Belvedere at Crooners, Minneapolis.

name: Chini Company / Chini Perez Domenech
whatItIs: Matanzas-born dancer, formerly of Afrocuba de Matanzas, who moved to Minnesota in 2011; performs with Rueda de la Calle and teaches Cuban and Latin dance in schools, studios and clubs.
evidence: McKnight fellow profile is undated; no 2025 or 2026 class or performance listing was found.

name: Minnesota Cuban Film Festival
whatItIs: Annual festival of films from Cuba since 2010, coordinated by the Minnesota Cuba Committee with MSP Film and Cuba's film institute ICAIC.
evidence: MSP Film lists 17th festival screenings on Wednesdays, March 4 to April 1, 2026.

name: Minnesota Cuba Committee
whatItIs: Group that helps organize the film festival and works with Cuban state cultural institutions; one political view among many.
evidence: Prensa Latina, April 5, 2026, quotes committee member Greg Klave on the 17th festival.

name: Cuban American Youth Orchestra
whatItIs: Exchange program for young U.S. and Cuban musicians that grew out of the Minnesota Orchestra's 2015 Havana tour; not an organization of Cuban Minnesotans.
evidence: Most recent opened source is MPR News, May 18, 2019.
